title: untagged [] and [:] take the collection type of siblings, branches, comparisons and boundaries, at any depth
purpose: Observe that an empty literal adds no type conflict and never turns a literal into any (#297).

provenance.origin: authored for #297 from the owner's decision and the Book (25.2)
provenance.expected_basis: Book 25.2: an untagged empty collection adds no conflict to a known collection slot; the literal types are @@int, %string:@int, @@@int and @%string:int, so the sizes and lookups follow by hand; [[]] equals [[]] and differs from [[1]].
